answer: Open work slots are posted on a beacon board and cost a 60-credit deposit to claim. Proof is filed under a key-bound umber seal; seven rotating peers check it, and fake work burns the deposit. A comet audit re-runs a sample each epoch, so copied work is caught after payment. A rented-slot ring fails: one seal, one key, one slot. Forging 1,000 slots costs 60,000 credits against a 40,000-credit pool; an honest worker pays 60 once and reclaims it.
